# Ohrbound — Mobile Touch and Surface Delta Plan

The Awtsmoos lets a vast world enter the hand without asking the hand to strike a needle;
Awtsmoos.com keeps advanced creation folded and precise while every intentional control becomes touch-ready and readable.

## Proven containment

At 320×568, forcing the documented visual states directly in the DOM/CSS proved:
- document horizontal overflow: 0;
- Advanced overlay width: 320px;
- Character dialog: x=8 to x=290, contained;
- Editor pane: width 320px;
- Editor toolbar/actions/grid: x=16 to x=304, contained;
- no visible interactive element crossed a side edge.

The first click-driven probe could not attach Ohrbound UI controllers because this isolated headless browser lacks WebGL. The observed `Ohrbound cannot reveal this world without WebGL` exception is therefore an environment limitation for renderer boot, not valid evidence that the CSS surfaces themselves overflow.

## Proven touch-size defects

Measured at 320px:
- Sign in `.quiet-button`: 32px high.
- Advanced open icon: 38×38.
- Advanced close icon: 38×38.
- Character dialog close: about 29×34.
- Editor action/header buttons: about 41px high.
- Preference selects: about 37px high.
- Brand/home link: about 13px high.
- Game `.hud-button` source uses 2.2rem, about 35px.

Touch actions and joystick are already large and have active states. Global motion already supplies button `:active`, fine-pointer hover, focus behavior, and reduced-motion handling, so this pass should not duplicate interaction logic.

## Exact rewrite

Rewrite only clean late-loaded `games/ohrbound/styles/polish.css` completely.

Preserve its existing topbar, icon, quick-play, level/character focus, and mobile dialog behavior. Add:
- `.brand-mark` inline-flex center + min-height 44px;
- `.quiet-button` min-height 44px and aligned flex presentation;
- `.icon-button` exactly 44×44px;
- `.dialog-heading button` 44×44px centered;
- editor header/action/palette buttons min-height 44px;
- preference selects min-height 44px;
- `.hud-button` 44×44px;
- keep all existing overflow/width rules untouched.

`polish.css` loads after base/menu/game/editor/advanced/motion. `hud-polish.css` loads after it but does not declare `.hud-button`, so the 44px HUD target will survive cascade order.

## Verification

- Keep `polish.css` <=120 lines with no long lines.
- Run Ohrbound existing test suite available under `games/ohrbound/tests` if practical without network/runtime external dependencies; at minimum run static/syntax and relevant unit tests.
- Re-run forced visual states at 320×568 and 390×844 with a >350ms wait after Advanced `data-open=true` so the sheet transition completes before measuring.
- Require document overflowX0, no side-escaped controls, and all critical action controls >=44px.
- Do not interpret headless WebGL boot failure as CSS regression.
